name: Givebutter
description:
Givebutter is the fundraising and donor management platform trusted by tens of thousands of nonprofits. This app connects your Givebutter account to Claude so your team can work with your fundraising data conversationally — no exports, no dashboards, no switching tabs.

Use it to:
- Look up donations, transactions, and payout activity across your campaigns
- Find and summarize donor and contact records, giving history, and engagement
- Check how a campaign, event, or fundraising page is performing
- Pull the numbers you need for board updates, grant reports, and end-of-month reconciliation

Ask things like:
- "How much did we raise in our spring appeal?"
- "Who are our top recurring donors this year?"
- "Summarize new donors from last week." 

Claude retrieves the answer directly from your live Givebutter data and respects your existing account permissions — it can only access what your connected account can see.

Built and maintained by Givebutter. Authentication is handled securely through OAuth; you stay in control of access and can disconnect at any time.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Givebutter to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Givebutter to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.givebutter.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Givebutter MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Givebutter provides these MCP tools: givebutter_help_center, givebutter_load_entity_context, givebutter_query, givebutter_who_am_i, and givebutter_widget_helper.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Givebutter?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Givebutter in nonprofit on the Manufact MCP catalog include Granted, hacesfalta, Benevity, Candid, and Chariot.
Givebutter requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Givebutter is developed by Givebutter. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
